comparison.objective: Place drill-core pieces into a tray in reading order and insert a core-loss block at the missing interval.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential grasping, orientation, ordered packing, and semantic placement of a loss marker.
comparison.success_condition: Core is boxed in the required order with the loss block in the correct position. Placement tolerances and damage rules are absent.
comparison.reason: Ordered specimen packing is materially different from bimanual impact-tool use, notch fracture, and physical recovery of released metal fragments.
